title: Pushkar vs Jodhpur: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Jodhpur for sightseeing and the Blue City magic. Pushkar for the vibe, spiritual atmosphere, and the Camel Fair. Do both if you have 10+ days.

categories.name: Sightseeing
categories.summary: Mehrangarh Fort is one of India's most dramatic forts. Pushkar's Brahma Temple and lake ghats are spiritual highlights.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Pushkar is slightly cheaper — dorms from ₹300, thalis from ₹100.

categories.name: Food
categories.summary: Jodhpur wins on variety. Pushkar is vegetarian and alcohol-free by law.

categories.name: Connectivity
categories.summary: Jodhpur has a major train station. Pushkar requires a 30-min auto from Ajmer.

categories.name: Hostel Scene
categories.summary: Pushkar has a stronger backpacker hostel scene for its size.

categories.name: Spiritual Atmosphere
categories.summary: Only Brahma Temple in India, 52 ghats, sacred lake.

categories.name: Photography
categories.summary: Blue City views from Mehrangarh are iconic.

faq.question: Is Pushkar or Jodhpur better for a first visit?
faq.answer: Jodhpur. Better sightseeing, better connectivity, more variety.
